data.source: Required --items-from: each graph's original step2_decision run items.json and permutation.json, copied without regeneration.
data.action: Same 100 directed test pairs, with original legal neighbor options and all successful successors accepted.
data.transition: Same legal-edge questions, without class resampling.
data.mismatch: Original saved derangement, shared by both new checkpoint groups.

interpretation: New checkpoints only; do not regenerate old text or original-report baselines. Primary comparison is report-plus-action versus equal-budget report continuation within this run. Correct/mismatched vectors use identical text and choice budgets. Latent-only three-slot probes remain a separate out-of-training-format diagnostic. Old text outputs are historical context.
